Chapter 11.2.1, Compressibility Factors for Hydrocarbons: 0-90 $ ^{\circ} $ API Gravity Range, First Edition, 1984

Range, First Edition, 1984 This chapter provides tables to correct hydrocarbon volumes metered under pressure to corresponding volumes at the equilibrium pressure for the metered temperature. It contains compressibility factors related to meter temperature and API gravity (60 $ ^{\circ} F $ ) of metered material. 149 pages. Price each, $12.00

*ASTM, 1916 Race Street, Philadelphia, PA 19103.
